description:
A long-awaited anime adaptation of a globally popular manga,
"Fool Night," the first collaboration between Sunrise and Shaft, starts streaming worldwide in 2026, only on Netflix.

"Living... there isn’t a single thing fun about it."

In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform.

Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant?
Which path would you choose in his situation?

description:
Sparks of Tomorrow comes exclusively to Netflix on July 5, with new episodes available weekly!

A bold new project directed by up-and-coming creator Minoru Ota.

A new frontier for Kyoto Animation! Stunning impressionistic backgrounds and intricately expressive animation bring to life the dreams of a young boy and girl, which spark a turbulent era of revolution.

Travel back to the not-so-distant past. In an alternate version of the early 20th century where progress halted after the invention of steam power, Kyoto is shrouded in ever-present smoke.
A boy becomes highly distrustful after the loss of his brother, with whom he dreamed of an "Age of Electricity." A highly spritiual girl hides her dreams and regrets for her deceased mother deep within her heart. When the two cross paths, they set about exploring the secrets of The 20th Century Electrical Catalog, which depicts the future they envision.
